messages:
maria: heads-up: reproduced a case where demote -> evict completes, but a racing prefetch writeback makes the prefix visible again. causes stale tokens to be served to the read path. anyone familiar with this repro?
aj: saw that once in a canary. root cause seemed to be writeback not validating demote epoch/marker before committing local slab.
ken: two main fixes we've kicked around: 1) strong CAS against prefix metadata at writeback time (linearizable, extra RPC) 2) tombstone/denylist hybrid: publish tombstone_epoch on demote + push in-memory denylist to slab coordinator for O(1) local checks.
clara: CAS is safest but adds latency on writeback hotpath. tombstone-only is cheap but can miss window if propagation lags. denylist helps close that window without global locks.
pavel: implementation sketch: demote -> increment tombstone_epoch in meta -> observer pushes (prefix, tombstone_epoch) to local slab coordinator denylist with short TTL (default 2s). writeback flow: check denylist O(1); if miss, read meta.tombstone_epoch; if tombstone_epoch > prefetch.epoch abort writeback; else commit.
maria: tradeoffs: denylist TTL tuning vs stale-saves. can we combine with best-effort prefetch cancellation on demote? try cancel, if fail rely on tombstone+denylist.
aj: metrics to add: prefetch_cancel_failures, denylist_hits, writeback_aborts_tombstone, stale_serves_detected. Alert if stale_serves_detected > 0.05% reads over 5m.
ken: api boundary: pin vs soft_pin must be explicit. pin(prefix) => hard lease, prevent demote until unpin. soft_pin(prefix, ttl) => advisory, demote allowed. docs need to be explicit to avoid support fallout.
clara: canary plan: spike denylist + tombstone check in writeback, measure overhead. I think denylist O(1) lookups are cheap; earlier sims showed ~0.5% CPU and modest p99 cost.
ops-bot: perf note: local denylist check in sim added ~0.4% CPU and ~+0.9ms p99 on writeback. link: internal/perf/581.
pavel: i'll wire observer push hook and expose tombstone_epoch in meta store.
maria: action items: (1) prototype denylist+tombstone guard (clara+pavel) (2) metrics + alert (aj) (3) pin semantics doc (ken) (4) canary + chaos tests after prototype (maria)
aj: i'll open the metrics PR today.
clara: will post microbench results here once spike is done.
ken: drafting docs now; will include migration notes for existing pin users.
maria: thanks — if anyone has trace snippets showing writeback after demote, paste here (esp showing prefetch_epoch vs tombstone_epoch). :thumbsup:
